# TASK-001 Spec Context

- Context-SHA256: `61db4762c87b751740ac876f3acd4b5d5655ab9af4b34d551c3fcb54f2991643`

## Required Rules
- `backend-database#RULE-backend-database-001`: All SQL must be parameterized and confined to `internal/repo` (or explicit migration helpers); schema changes must be idempotent or versioned and must not destroy user data silently.
  - rule_sha256=271a8d50f306d28f18a4c75db949f3d3dbe8cfbbef330dfbf14e34752a361d79 verifier=backend-database#RULE-backend-database-001; artifacts=skill-execution-control-and-review.backend.design.md,skill-execution-control-and-review.md
- `backend-database#RULE-backend-no-select-star-001`: Queries must list explicit columns; do not use `SELECT *` in production SQL.
  - rule_sha256=e79cf84dfe56ac5ae802934859989b84698af26407b1619a44285cccff7464b3 verifier=backend-database#RULE-backend-no-select-star-001; artifacts=skill-execution-control-and-review.backend.design.md,skill-execution-control-and-review.md

## Acceptance Contract
| 场景ID | 测试层级 | 不得 Mock 的真实边界 | 关键断言 | 测试文件 / 用例 | 执行命令 | 状态 |
|--------|---------|--------------------|---------|----------------|---------|------|
| RULE-backend-database-001 | integration | 真实 SQLite 文件、迁移脚本 | 旧库升级成功；重复执行幂等；行数与关联保留 | `console/backend/test/schema_test.go` | `cd console/backend && go test ./test -run Schema -count=1` | verified |
| RULE-backend-no-select-star-001 | unit | 生产 SQL 文本 | 无 `SELECT *` | repo 测试 + 正则扫描 | `cd console/backend && go test ./internal/repo -count=1` | verified |
